asset.calibrationNotes: Contact points are manual contour estimates on a soft bag; rear contact is inferred. Do not fit an affine camera transform to these points. Uniform scaling only. Initial generation envelope was 0.36 x 0.22 tile / 32 px vertical height; display body width reduced uniformly to 32 px for portable scale beside the approved 125% player. Shoulder straps extend beyond the body footprint.
